identify: The photo model matched this to damage by the rice hispa beetle.
The rice hispa is a regional rice pest.

thresholds.etl: Early to late tillering: 2 adults or 2 dead leaf /hill.

cultural: Clip the top three-fourths of the leaves of a badly infested young crop. This removes the eggs and grubs.
Collect the adults with a sweep net and destroy them.
